notes.title: We've reached Version 0.1.4!
notes.content: [h1]Your feedback[/h1][p]We are currently at [b]version 0.1.4[/b], and thanks to some feedback from the[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3703150/discussions/"] Steam community discussion[/url], I saw that some people were having difficulties and getting stuck when trying to find the two fragments in the cat mission. The intention of this part is not to be difficult, nor to instigate an investigative puzzle (not at the moment). So I fixed the problem, making it much more accessible for everyone. Someone contacted me about the use of controls, and [b]at the moment[/b] I am unable to provide that.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610895/172298c120fc3c065d5e43d4b780ace8776fb232.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]CRT effect and shadows![/h2][p]If you notice, in previous versions, the CRT effect did not exist. I am adding this as something new to the game, and I hope the community will tell me what they think. Let me know in the comments or on our \[[url="https://discord.gg/ByqgpY3E7u"]Discord server[/url]]. Also, while playing Earthbound recently, I noticed the way they create shadows, so I decided to implement it in Revella, and I would like to know if you are satisfied with the new look![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610895/c3ef669f527402246e1073748c97ab2072c831d2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Achievements and Map Update[/h2][p]The village map has been completely redesigned, and now you can access a new area that was not previously accessible. In addition, two more [strike](secret)[/strike] achievements have been added, which will be extremely important for the final game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610895/63f9ec3047df054a1ff61ad0d32324abea776e6b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Acknowledgments and the future[/h3][p]I would like to express my immense gratitude for the publicity that many of you are providing through YouTube and X. This is truly incredible and something I was not expecting to happen! As a result, we have reached the milestone of 1,000 wishlists from April to August! I will soon be updating the game with the new chapter of the Demo, and I hope everyone likes the mechanics that will be added to the game![/p][p][/p][p]I sincerely thank everyone who is part of the Revella community![/p]

notes.title: QOL and Bugs Update 0.1.3.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Based on initial feedback, I've improved some things related to the speed of battle, slowing down the text so that damage and actions can be visualized more concretely.
[*] The menu has also been completely changed with fullscreen options and a NEW feature! The controls to be used in WASD, because first-person shooter (FPS) players should feel right at home, shouldn't they?
[*] The menu screen has been changed to a more up-to-date version.
[*] Correction of texts that were not written correctly.
[/list]

[h2]What can you expect in the next updates?[/h2]
We're still focusing on listening to player feedback, improvements to battles and sprites are on the way! Also, with a new area to explore soon (The Caves).

Be sure to add the game to your Steam wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703150/Revella/

notes.title: [DEMO] Try the opening chapter of Revella!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=o0d_bkSrQ_M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Revella Demo 0.1.2 is officially available![/h1]
You can now experience all the new features of Revella and the world of Aveline here on Steam!

[h2]What's in Demo 0.1.2?[/h2]
The current version brings several changes to the internal and external scenery of the world of Revella, such as the alternation between day and night, with graphical adjustments in pixel art depending on the time of day. Additionally, parts of the game have been reworked with a new script and storyline. Secrets have been added to the game to unlock new ways to connect with the world of Revella (there will be many more secrets to discover as updates are released).

New NPCs have been added and an alternate costume for Aveline has also been created. You just need to know how to get it! Alternatively, on the Steam version, we will bring the achievement "The End?", representing the completion of the first part of the Demo. With this, the Demo will bring 2 future achievements, representing the end of Chapter 1 and the end of Chapter 2, where the Demo will officially end.

With all these new features, it is normal that there will be some bugs, including visual ones, so I encourage you to join our server on [[url=https://discord.gg/SUpc9rVxJR]DISCORD[/url]] and update with bug reports, as well as feedback on the game. I will be actively listening to the community to bring you the experience that Revella should have when it officially launches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610895/3e8c2907ab1f0ceb1f526f324d4db252b09606c5.png[/img]

v 0.1.2
Chapter 0 released as a demo on Steam and Itch.io and gathering feedback on Discord!

v 0.2.0
Chapter 1 with new additions to the demo!

v 0.3.0
Chapter 2 and the last chapter of the Demo, this one being the closest to the final result.
